name: Buddy Israel Exits Neon-Lit Nightclub with Two Young Companions
description: Neon-framed doors swing open as Buddy Israel steps onto the Las Vegas strip, his hair slicked back, skin tinted from a store-bought tan. He moves with a swagger, flanked by two younger companions on each arm, their presence amplifying the spectacle of his arrival. The lights flash, the music spills into the night, and he grins, striding forward as if claiming the street.
related_events: Buddy Israel exits nightclub with companions

name: Dr. Gill Warns Israel of Heart Danger from Cocaine Use
description: Dr. Gregory Gill rushes down a hallway, medical report in hand, and intercepts Israel. He tells Israel he has serious concerns about cocaine use and the amount Israel is taking. Israel denies using cocaine. Gill responds that he is not there to judge but to save his life, warning that the cardiology results show severe cardiac distress. He says two heart specialists have reviewed the findings and agree that Israel is at immediate risk of a massive coronary. Israel remains silent, his expression grave.
related_events: Dr. Gill confronts Israel about cocaine use and cardiac distress

name: Dupree Describes Neo-Nazi Group During Pool Game
description: Dupree chalking his cue, speaks about a group of neo-Nazis who are heavily into speed and deeply committed to their ideology, claiming they recite 'Mein Kampf' like nursery rhymes and can turn violent without warning. As he finishes speaking, Sykes asks from off-screen what the group's name is again.
related_events: Dupree prepares to play pool by chalking his cue
Dupree describes extremist group's ideology and behavior
Sykes asks for clarification on the group's name

name: Locke Confirms Threat, Sykes Demands Proof
description: Locke reviews the wiretap data and confirms that Sparazza is behind a high-value contract targeting Israel. The evidence includes a recently opened, cash-rich escrow account linked to Sparazza and references to a mysterious Swede. After Locke presents the findings, Sykes voices doubt, questioning how real the threat actually is, prompting the need for further verification.
related_events: Locke confirms intelligence about Sparazza's contract on Israel
Sykes questions the credibility of the threat against Israel

name: Wyman, Sykes, and Watters Meet at the Diner
description: Wyman, Sykes, and Watters meet again at a greasy spoon diner. Sitting across from each other, they talk about the case. Wyman leans in and says the name Lazlo Soot. He says a lot of people are looking for this white boy, that he’s wanted by several different groups. He adds that Soot might be working for one of them.
related_events: Wyman, Sykes, and Watters reconvene at the greasy spoon diner
Wyman reveals information about Lazlo Soot

name: Lock the Door and Check the Time
description: Israel locks the door, then looks at the wall clock. He asks Dr. Gill if he is using a land line. Dr. Gill says yes and asks why. Israel says he is just checking, then asks what is wrong with Dr. Gill's voice.
related_events: Israel throws the lock
Israel checks the wall clock
Israel asks Dr. Gill about using a land line
Israel notices change in Dr. Gill's voice

name: Lavernel Argues with Employers and Becomes Magician's Assistant
description: A row of chorus girls, gilded like gold-flaked flamingos, rub coca-butter on their bare midriffs. The camera finds Lavernel, visibly pregnant, arguing with her employers during performance preparation. She tries to suck in her belly, yelling, "bullshit, you just have to light it right..." Later, she works as a magician's assistant.
related_events: Lavernel performs as a showgirl with coca-butter application
Lavernel argues with employers during performance preparation
Lavernel transitions to role of magician's assistant

name: Shoot Freeman Heller and Flee the Scene
description: A top-coated gunman moves through the shadows alongside a crashed '51 Ford Fairlane, its body pocked with bullet holes and draped with a dead man. Freeman Heller, the only one still alive, stumbles from the wreckage and collapses onto the ground. The gunman steps forward, raises a .45 pistol, and fires. Heller does not move again. The gunman turns, walks calmly to his own car, gets in, and drives away.
related_events: Gunman stalks survivor of crashed vehicle
Gunman shoots Freeman Heller after car ambush
Gunman retreats to his car after shooting

name: Dr. Gill Arrives and Waits for Hugo
description: A learjet touches down at the airport. Dr. Gill steps out and makes his way to a payphone. The sound of taxiing aircraft fills the air, making it difficult to hear. He speaks into the phone, raising his voice to be heard. 'I'm here, where's the car?' Israel's voice comes through on the other end. 'I sent Hugo, he should be there!' Dr. Gill scans the area, turning as he looks around. 'Well I don't see him,' he says. 'Should I take a taxi or what?' Israel replies, 'No, wait there. He'll be there.' Dr. Gill stays at the payphone, watching the arrivals.
related_events: Dr. Gill arrives and attempts to contact Israel from a payphone
Israel instructs Dr. Gill to wait for Hugo over the phone
Dr. Gill looks around for Hugo upon arrival

name: Tremor Brother's Last Stand During Police Arrival
description: The wounded Tremor brother carries one sibling on his back and drags another by the scruff of the neck across the concrete. Nearby, police sirens wail as McGarey crawls toward his car, his hairpiece hanging loose. As the sirens grow louder, the Tremor brother reaches into his blind brother's coat, pulls out a revolver, and begins firing.
related_events: Tremor brother carries injured siblings across concrete
McGarey crawls toward his car with damaged hairpiece
Police sirens activate nearby
Tremor brother retrieves revolver and opens fire

name: Dispatch to Lake Tahoe
description: After Buddy Israel skips bail, agents from the firm of Culpepper, Brody and Reed—under investigation by the SEC and Treasury Department—scramble to locate him before his bond expires. Rupert Reed sends bondsman Jack Dupree to track Israel down and bring him back to Las Vegas. At the same time, a Gulf Stream jet is prepped at Reagan International for an emergency flight to Lake Tahoe, where Israel is believed to be hiding. The team moves quickly, aware that time is running out.
related_events: Buddy Israel skips bail and evades legal custody
Joint SEC and Treasury Department probe targets Culpepper, Brody and Reed
Rupert Reed dispatches Jack Dupree to apprehend Buddy Israel
Gulf Stream arranged for emergency transport to Lake Tahoe
related_occasions: Emergency Operation To Intercept Buddy Israel

name: Buddy Learns Cards from Mandrake, Mandrake Gets Beat Down
description: Jack Dupree stands at a billiard table in a smoky bar, speaking with Hollis Elmore and Pistol Pete Deeks. He tells them how young Buddy learned to play cards from Mandrake, a magician who was also a gambler. The scene shifts to a flashback: Mandrake, inside a mob-owned poker parlor, is caught dealing from the bottom of the deck. In response, men pelt him with poker chips, kick him in the face, and urinate on him. The beating leaves him barely conscious, lying on the floor in a pool of smoke and blood.
related_events: Jack Dupree discusses Buddy's card education with Hollis Elmore and Pistol Pete Deeks
Magician is attacked and humiliated in a mob-owned poker parlor
related_occasions: Billiard Table Gathering At A Smoky Bar

name: Locke Reveals Legal Peril and Mecklen's Custody Promise
description: Locke delivers news of the case turning against them, with a meeting set for twenty-four hours from now between the client and federal prosecutors. He explains that Morris Mecklen, the client’s agent, has promised the client will enter protective custody as soon as the deal is approved. Mecklen, seated at his desk, talks loudly on the phone, surrounded by framed photos of Vegas legends—Wayne Newton, Buddy Hackett, Carol Channing, and a heavy, aging Elvis—while Locke’s voice continues over the scene, revealing that they’ve been tracking Mecklen’s calls and have learned the client is staying under a false name on the penthouse level of the Nomad Hotel and Casino in Lake Tahoe, Nevada.
related_events: Locke announces potential case loss and upcoming meeting with federal prosecutors
Morris Mecklen guarantees entry into protective custody upon deal approval

name: Locke Tracks Israel's Location Through Mecklen's Call
description: Morris Mecklen sits at his desk, speaking on the phone. Around him, framed photos of Wayne Newton, Buddy Hackett, Carol Channing, and a heavy, aging Elvis decorate the wall. Unseen by Mecklen, Locke and his team intercept the conversation. From the call, they learn that Israel is staying in the penthouse of the Nomad Hotel and Casino in Lake Tahoe under a false name.
related_events: Morris Mecklen speaks on the phone at his desk
Locke monitors Mecklen's calls and discovers Israel's location

name: The Brothers Enter the Hotel
description: Darwin, Lester, and Jeeves stand apart in full security uniforms, heads down, hands in their pockets. Darwin watches his brothers closely, signaling silently with his hands. Each man approaches the check-in point separately, punches in, and signs the time sheet. Unnoticed by the other security staff, they move together through the lower floors of the hotel, passing the fitness center and indoor pool. A child splashes into the water with a cannonball as they walk by.
related_events: The brothers sign in and enter the hotel security system
Darwin monitors his brothers using hand signals
The brothers move through the hotel's lower floors

name: Passing the Pool During a Cannonball
description: Darwin, Lester, and Jeeves move through the lower floors of the hotel, dressed in security uniforms. They keep apart from one another, heads down, hands in their pockets. Darwin watches his brothers closely, signaling silently with his hands. They pass through the fitness center and approach the indoor pool just as a child jumps in with a cannonball, sending up a splash. Water ripples across the surface. The brothers continue on without stopping.
related_events: A child performs a cannonball into the pool

name: Laverne Israel Helps Magician on Stage
description: In a dimly lit dive bar, Laverne Israel stands beside a magician with a pompadour hairstyle, handing him props and guiding a deck of cards through a series of quick, precise movements. The audience watches closely as the illusion unfolds under the flickering stage lights. Nearby, in the lounge, a young boy named Buddy sits on a stripper’s lap, shuffling a deck of cards while glancing toward the stage.
related_events: Laverne Israel assists magician during performance
related_occasions: Dive Bar Stage Performance

name: Young Buddy Plays Cards on Stripper's Lap
description: In the dimly lit lounge of a second-rate dive bar, a young boy named Buddy sits on the lap of a stripper. Around him, the low hum of the venue fills the air as a magician with a pompadour performs on stage, assisted by Laverne Israel. Unbothered, Buddy flips through a deck of cards, shuffling and dealing them into small piles on his knees.
related_events: Young Buddy plays with deck of cards on stripper's lap
related_occasions: Dive Bar Stage Performance

name: Sykes readies weapon and adjusts comms in disguise
description: Sykes slid a Glock 9mm into place, adjusted her leather mini-skirt, lace garters, and thigh-high platform boots as part of her disguise. She fine-tuned the earpiece and microphone she wore. Watters' voice crackled over the line, complaining of feedback. Sykes pulled the earpiece out, made an adjustment, and reinserted it. "Better?" she asked.
related_events: Sykes prepares for mission in tactical hooker disguise
Sykes adjusts earpiece after receiving feedback complaint

name: Sykes Sets the Rules
description: Sykes tucks a Glock 9mm into place and adjusts the earpiece and microphone she's wearing. She's dressed in a leather mini-skirt, lace garters, and thigh-high platform boots—outfitted in sharp, provocative gear. She says they shouldn't draw more trouble than necessary. They'll only target people who are directly in their way on the path to Israel. She makes it clear she doesn't want to kill everyone in the room, and she won't kill women, no matter what they do for a living. Watters reports feedback in his earpiece. Sykes removes her own earpiece, fiddles with it, then puts it back in. 'Better?' she asks.
related_events: Sykes states intent to minimize collateral damage

name: Dupree Describes the Tremor Brothers
description: Dupree chalking his cue, lines up a shot at the pool table. He glances at Deeks and Elmore, unimpressed by their blank expressions. 'No?' he says. 'Then you've both been living under the same rock, 'cuz these cocksuckers are infamous.' He explains they're three brothers, same mother, different fathers, raised in chaos. Known for reckless, deadly attacks where they don't expect to walk away. Deeks recalls a major shootout in Cleveland months ago—the club wiped out. Elmore asks what happened. Dupree says the Teamsters were holding a black-tie event downtown the night of a reform vote that threatened the local syndicate. The Tremor Brothers showed up and crashed it—literally.
related_events: Dupree prepares to take a pool shot
Dupree reveals the notoriety of the Tremor Brothers
related_occasions: Teamsters Reform Ballot Black-Tie Event

name: Dupree Tells of the Tremor Brothers' Attack on the Teamsters Event
description: Dupree chalking his cue, sets it aside and looks at Deeks and Elmore. Seeing their blank expressions, he tells them they must have been living under a rock, because the Tremor Brothers are infamous. He explains that the brothers, three sons of the same woman with different fathers, are known for their reckless, suicidal style of violence. Deeks recalls a major shootout in Cleveland a few months back and asks if that’s the incident being referred to. Elmore wants to know what happened. Dupree says the Teamsters were holding a black-tie event downtown on the night of a union reform vote, a ballot measure that had angered the local syndicate. As the night unfolded, the Tremor Brothers arrived and crashed the event—breaking in and launching a violent assault on the gathering.
related_events: Tremor Brothers disrupt Teamsters ballot event
Deeks recalls a major shootout in Cleveland
Elmore asks for details about the Cleveland incident
related_occasions: Teamsters Reform Ballot Black-Tie Event

name: Buddy Israel Learns Card Tricks from the Magician
description: The Magician lies immobilized in a full body cast, taking his meals through a straw. Young Buddy Israel sits beside him, practicing card tricks and performing them for his mentor. Over time, Buddy becomes skilled with the deck, and by the age of twelve, he handles cards with remarkable talent.
related_events: Young Israel performs card tricks for the Magician
Buddy Israel masters sleight of hand by age twelve

name: Buddy Israel Headlines at MGM
description: By the age of sixteen, Buddy Israel stands on the main stage at MGM, cards and coins dancing across his fingertips as he performs for a packed audience. The crowd watches in awe, captivated by his precision and flair. In the front row, Laverne Israel, wrapped in an ankle-length fur coat, claps enthusiastically, her face lit with pride.
related_events: Buddy Israel headlines at MGM's main room by age sixteen
Buddy Israel dazzles sold-out crowds with card and coin tricks
Laverne Israel applauds Buddy from the front row

name: Ivy and Beanie Manage the Hookers' Exit
description: Ivy and Beanie directed the women out of the suite, one by one, in an orderly departure. Ivy stood near the exit, handing each woman her payment as she left. The room emptied quickly, the mood subdued, the night’s work coming to a close under their watch.
related_events: Ivy and Beanie oversee exodus of hookers from suite
Ivy distributes payments to departing hookers

name: Beanie Helps and Scolds a Fallen Hooker
description: A young hooker, unsteady in her stripper heels, takes a wobbly step forward, loses her balance, and crashes face-first into a glass coffee table, shattering it. The other women turn to look, momentarily still, some with faint amusement on their faces. Beanie rushes over, grabs the fallen woman by the arms, and yanks her to her feet. She brushes glass shards from the woman’s skin and straightens her clothes with quick, sharp movements. Beanie pulls off the high heels, holds one up, and snaps, 'All these good for is poppin’ them titties girl, but y’see what happens when you try to get around in ’em?' The young woman stands barefoot, trembling, glass dust clinging to her arms, swaying slightly. Beanie gives her a hard shove toward the door. The woman stumbles forward and exits. Beanie turns away, already moving on.
related_events: Young hooker loses balance and crashes into glass coffee table
Beanie helps fallen young hooker to her feet and removes her high heels
Beanie scolds young hooker about wearing high heels
Beanie shoves young hooker toward the door after incident

name: Pasquale Acosta Fakes Inspection to Test Casino Security
description: Pasquale Acosta, disguised in a suit and posing as a federal agent, approaches a casino employee and announces he is conducting impromptu inspections for the Nevada Gaming Commission. The employee, visibly compliant, nods and hurries off to find the head of security. Acosta remains behind, scanning the room with a quiet gaze. He takes in the guards—underpaid, loosely organized, wearing maroon uniforms with gold buttons and brown piping. A faint smile crosses his lips as he surveys the scene.
related_events: Gerald Diego reveals disguised identity as Pasquale Acosta
Pasquale Acosta claims to conduct impromptu inspections for Nevada Gaming Commission
Casino employee agrees to fetch head of security
Pasquale Acosta assesses casino security and smiles

name: Deeks Questions the Source of the Uniforms
description: The scene shifts to reveal the Nomad's security staff wearing maroon uniforms with burnished gold buttons and brown piping down the slacks—identical to three sets laid out across the trunk of a rental car. Deeks, off-screen, asks where the uniforms came from, his voice edged with suspicion.
related_events: Three guard uniforms displayed on rental car trunk
Camera reveals Nomad's security staff wearing identical guard uniforms
Deeks questions origin of guard uniforms

name: Israel Issues Ultimatum While Hugo Contacts Vitoli/Soot
description: Israel lies on a baby-grand piano, its legs sawed off, shuffling a deck of cards in his hands. Lines of cocaine are arranged neatly on the piano's surface. He shouts that the deal is off unless his associates face no jail time, giving ten seconds for compliance. Mecklen responds from off-screen, saying it is what it is. In the background, Hugo speaks on the phone with Vitoli/Soot.
related_events: Israel threatens to cancel the deal over jail time
Mecklen dismisses Israel's demand with indifference
Hugo makes a phone call to Vitoli/Soot

name: Israel Prepares Cocaine on a Sawed-Off Piano
description: The legs of a baby-grand piano have been sawed off, leaving it resting low on the floor. Israel lies on top of it, shuffling a deck of cards in his hands. On the piano's surface, cocaine has been cut into neat, straight rows, ready to be snorted. The room bears traces of the previous night's excess. In the background, Hugo speaks on the phone to Vitoli or Soot, while Israel shouts that the deal is off unless his terms are met immediately.
related_events: Cocaine is prepared and arranged on a piano

name: Carruthers Orders Immediate Arrest Operation
description: Carruthers snapped his cellphone shut and told Messner that Israel was giving up his entire entourage. He insisted they move immediately, citing Israel's high risk of flight. Messner asked if the Justice lawyers had approved the action, but Carruthers said the approval was still ten minutes away and they couldn't wait. As they reached their car, Carruthers ordered the sheriff's task force to mobilize. He then called security to lock down the elevators and secure the stairwells, aiming to keep Israel contained in the penthouse. A security supervisor responded that the penthouse was under construction.
related_events: Carruthers closes his cellphone after receiving a call
Carruthers reveals Israel is giving up his entourage
Carruthers decides to initiate immediate action
Messner inquires about Justice lawyers' approval
Carruthers orders mobilization of the sheriff's task force
Carruthers plans to lock down building access

name: Security Supervisor Reports Penthouse Under Construction
description: As the agents moved to secure the building, Carruthers contacted security to lock down the elevators and secure the stairwells, aiming to contain Israel in the penthouse. Before the orders could be carried out, the security supervisor responded that the penthouse was currently under construction, making it impossible to seal off as planned.
related_events: Security supervisor reports penthouse is under construction

name: Elmore Emerges from Lake Tahoe After Assassination Attempt
description: Elmore awakens in the freezing waters of Lake Tahoe, naked and shaking violently. His skin is a deep bruised blue, his fingertips turning black from the cold. He feels sharp, bone-deep pain and presses a hand to the side of his head, finding a dried bullet graze caked with blood. He struggles to steady his breathing, then begins crawling out of the water. His muscles spasm and cramp as he drags himself across the sand, collapsing just beyond the shore. Behind him, the bodies of Deeks and Dupree float face down in the shallows, gently rocked by the tide.
related_events: Elmore awakens naked in sub-zero waters of Lake Tahoe
Elmore experiences severe hypothermia and physical trauma
Elmore discovers head wound from bullet graze
Elmore crawls from sub-zero waters onto the sand
related_occasions: Sheriff'S Task Force Investigation At Lake Tahoe

name: Elmore Sees the Bodies in the Lake
description: Elmore crawls from the icy water onto the sand, his body shaking, skin bruised blue, fingers turning black with cold. He collapses, unable to go further, and turns back to look at the lake. Deeks and Dupree float face down in the shallow water, their bodies gently rocked by the tide. The cold wind sweeps across the shore, and Elmore stares at them, blood dried along the side of his head, his left hand missing three fingers.
related_events: Elmore observes bodies of Deeks and Dupree in Lake Tahoe
related_occasions: Sheriff'S Task Force Investigation At Lake Tahoe

name: Dupree's Eight Ball Shot
description: Dupree lines up a shot at the pool table, aiming the eight ball toward the corner pocket. The cue strikes, but the ball veers off course. His next attempts are clumsy, the game unraveling quickly. As he plays, police begin to gather outside the bar, watching, taking notes. They jot down names, snap photos. Inside, the tension rises. The noise of the game fades beneath the weight of what’s happening beyond the table. A man named Primo Sparraza receives a call. He listens, then hangs up, his expression darkening.
related_events: Dupree attempts to shoot eight ball into corner pocket

name: Dupree's Mistakes Draw Police to the Carlotta Organization
description: Dupree attempts to play the eight ball into the corner pocket but fumbles the shot. His lack of skill becomes obvious as he continues to make careless moves, drawing unwanted attention. Officers begin to take notice, stationing themselves nearby and recording names and faces. The investigation soon reaches Primo Sparraza, an enforcer tied to the organization, as police scrutiny intensifies around the operation.
related_events: Dupree's incompetence exposes Carlotta organization
Police begin surveillance on Carlotta organization

name: Police Close In on Primo Sparraza
description: Dupree sinks the eight ball into the corner pocket. His play draws attention, but he fumbles, revealing his inexperience. Mistakes pile up quickly, exposing the Carlotta organization. Police grow suspicious, begin staking out locations, and start recording names and faces. The investigation escalates until it reaches Primo Sparraza—a feared enforcer, extortionist, and killer.
related_events: Israel's actions bring police attention to Primo Sparraza

name: Dr. Gill Confronts Israel Over Heart Condition
description: Israel stands in pain, clutching his chest, breathing shallowly. On the phone, Dr. Gill warns him that continued cocaine use is causing severe damage to his heart and could lead to cardiac arrest. He explains that immediate treatment is necessary and insists on seeing Israel in person to administer care. Israel resists, saying it’s not possible, but Dr. Gill presses him, describing the worsening consequences of his condition. Finally, Israel relents and tells Dr. Gill he is in Lake Tahoe. He says he will have Hugo book a flight and arrange for Dr. Gill to be met at the airport. After hanging up, Dr. Gill dials another number and says, 'He's in Lake Tahoe.' Israel remains in the room, still unsteady, rubbing his chest. He walks to a bureau where lines of cocaine are laid out, rolls a hundred-dollar bill, and snorts one last line, whispering to himself that this is the final time.
related_events: Israel experiences chest pain and physical distress
Dr. Gill warns Israel about cardiac risks of cocaine abuse
Dr. Gill describes dire medical consequences of untreated condition
Dr. Gill insists on immediate in-person medical intervention
Israel initially refuses medical help
Israel reveals location and arranges for Dr. Gill's arrival

name: Dr. Gill Reveals Israel's Location
description: After ending the call with Israel, Dr. Gill pauses, then dials another number. He waits, then tells someone on the other end, 'He's in Lake Tahoe.'
related_events: Dr. Gill contacts another party after phone call ends
Dr. Gill discloses Israel's location to an unknown party

name: Israel Uses Cocaine After Medical Warning
description: Israel stands by the bureau, wincing and breathing shallowly, one hand pressed to his chest. Without hesitation, he rolls a hundred-dollar bill, bends over the table, and snorts a line of cocaine. His eyes close briefly as he straightens up, murmuring to himself that it’s just this last time, then it’s over.
related_events: Israel uses cocaine despite chest pain and medical warning

name: Sykes Proposes Strategy Over Dinner
description: Watters nods, wiping red sauce off her fingers as she listens. Sykes sets her fork down and wipes her hands on a napkin. She states that they need to lay out a plan, something tight, warning that going in without one could get someone killed. Watters asks about the split, and Wyman responds with the terms. Sykes presses for the time frame, and Wyman insists they move immediately, saying they can't afford to wait any longer.
related_events: Sykes sets fork down and wipes hands on napkin
Sykes insists on establishing a strategy before proceeding

name: Watters and Sykes Negotiate Payment with Wyman
description: Watters wipes red sauce off her fingers and asks about the split of earnings. Wyman responds that Watters and Sykes will get forty-five dollars each, with a ten percent finder's fee going to him. Sykes sets her fork down and asks about the time frame. Wyman says they need to move immediately, insisting there's no time to wait.
related_events: Watters inquires about the split of earnings
Wyman proposes payment of forty-five each for Watters and Sykes with ten percent finder's fee for himself

name: Wyman and Messner Push for Immediate Action
description: Wyman wipes red sauce off her fingers and nods. She tells the others the target is three hours east—a day trip—and mentions it's pretty this time of year. Sykes sets her fork down and wipes her hands on a napkin, saying they need a tight strategy, warning that going in without a plan means putting themselves at risk. Watters asks about the split. Wyman says forty-five apiece for them, ten percent finder’s fee for her. Sykes wants to know the time frame. Wyman says right now, as fast as they can move. She stresses that waiting any longer means someone’s going to die. Messner’s voice is heard off-screen, adding that if they delay, they’ll lose their witness.
related_events: Wyman states the operation must begin immediately
Messner voices concern about losing the witness

name: Watters Finishes Eating and the Group Turns to Planning
description: Watters nodded and wiped red sauce from her fingers as the meal wound down. Sykes set her fork aside and wiped her hands with a napkin. The conversation shifted, voices lowering as they began to discuss what came next.
related_events: Watters wipes red sauce off her fingers during a meal

name: The False Threat
description: A dark-suited man walks toward a trio of well-dressed men, his hands buried in his pockets. The bodyguards tense, watching his approach. He pulls a hand free and lifts a cellphone, holding it up as he passes. The guards relax. The moment of calm settles over the crosswalk.
related_events: Dark-suited man approaches trio of suits with hands in pockets
Bodyguards react to perceived threat from dark-suited man
Dark-suited man reveals cellphone instead of weapon

name: The Fake Invalid Attacks with Hidden Uzis
description: The man in the wheelchair, feigning full paralysis, suddenly throws off the quilt covering his lap. His contorted expression vanishes as he pulls two Uzi machine-pistols from beneath the blanket. He opens fire at point-blank range, bullets tearing into the bodyguards before they can react. The three suited men collapse as the gunfire continues. With both guns emptied, the man leaps from the wheelchair, grabs onto a passing truck, and is pulled away from the scene.
related_events: Crippled cat reveals hidden Uzi machine-pistols and opens fire
Bodyguards are shot while unprepared
Trio of suits collapses under gunfire

name: The Cripple Who Wasn't: Ambush and Escape
description: The man in the wheelchair, his face twisted in apparent disability, throws off the quilt covering his lap. In one motion, he raises two Uzi machine-pistols, fires point-blank into the group of suited men and their bodyguards. The three suits fall, the bodyguards cut down before they can react. Smoke curls from the spent weapons as he drops the empty guns, stands smoothly from the wheelchair, and in the chaos, leaps onto a passing truck, grabbing hold as it carries him away.
related_events: Phony invalid empties both guns and escapes
Dark-Suited Man hijacks passing truck to escape

name: Pedestrians Cross at Noon
description: At noon, a busy crosswalk fills with people. A woman carries shopping bags, a skateboarder weaves through the crowd, an elderly man walks a dog, and a man in a wheelchair sits motionless, a quilt draped over his lap. The street hums with the usual rhythm of city life as pedestrians move in all directions, passing one another without incident.
related_events: Pedestrians move through crowded crosswalk during noon hour

name: Carruthers Takes the Call
description: Special Agent Carruthers answers a cellphone. He listens, then speaks: 'Yes Sir. Go ahead.' He checks his watch. 'We're three miles from The Nomad now. We'll be awaiting word.' He ends the call and clicks the phone off.
related_events: Special Agent Carruthers answers a cellphone call

name: Listening to the Tape, Talking About the Swede
description: Messner sits in the passenger seat, headphones on, listening to a surveillance recording. The voice of Sidney Serna comes through: 'so, I'm thinkin' we jump, do this in the next day or so, get to Israel before the Swede can--' Messner pulls the headphones off and looks at Carruthers. 'Anything on the Swede?' Carruthers shakes his head. 'Only the mention made in that phone call. There's no Swedish hitman of any renown, much less one with a million dollar day rate.' Messner considers this. 'Maybe he's that good. Never been caught, no criminal record.' Carruthers gives a noncommittal response. 'Maybe.' Messner sets the playback device on the floor, stretches, and flips through photographs of Victor Padiche and Sidney Serna.
related_events: Messner listens to surveillance tape excerpt
Messner removes headphones after hearing tape
Carruthers reports lack of intelligence on the Swede
Messner speculates about the Swede's skill level

name: Messner and Carruthers Choose the Operation Site
description: Messner set the surveillance gear on the floorboard and stretched. He turned over photographs of Victor Padiche and Sidney Serna, studying their faces. 'I tell you, engineering this kind of play against Sparazza, going to the lengths these guys are going to... they're playing some long odds,' he said. Carruthers nodded. 'And a very bad gamble.' Messner glanced out at the passing neon lights, then said, 'Well... this is as good a place for it as any I guess.'
related_events: Messner places surveillance gear on floorboard and stretches
Messner examines photographs of Victor Padiche and Sidney Serna
Messner comments on the riskiness of the operation against Sparazza

Dupree searches his pockets, then says it was Israel’s own law firm—the same one that hired him. Israel walked free and hasn’t been seen since. Elmore argues that if Israel really is the mob’s top snitch, then the mob is hunting him with everything they’ve got, sending dangerous men to kill him. He sees no sense in walking into that. He scoffs at the idea, comparing it to storming Fort Knox with a slingshot or chasing Hitler into Hell. Dupree blows smoke, flicks ash, and says, 'So I guess you're not going.' Elmore doesn’t answer. By twenty-one, he’s embedded in their world, sharing meals with the most powerful men, drawing attention wherever he goes.
